svg.title: inferCSN: input, sparse regression, evidence and networks
svg.desc: A four-panel schematic matching the multiCSN homepage. Expression matrices, optional supplied pseudotime and gene subsets enter Greedy-L0 sparse regression. Edge-deletion BIC evidence is transformed into signed ordinal weights. Static and pseudotime-informed networks illustrate alternative inference modes. All matrices, cells and networks are schematic.

g.text: BIC(S) = n log[max{RSS(S) / n, 10⁻¹²}] + |S| log n
One sparse model per target gene
BIC-guided add / drop / swap and refit
Signed weight = sign(β) × ordinal evidence rank
